operations.content: TrailCode/Graft MCP: only @nanonets/graft@0.15.0 lists tools eagerly to this client; 0.25.x and @trailhq/trail-code serve deferred tools that read as 0 tools. Always pin 0.15.0 in wrapper scripts.

Graft MCP resolves its repo from process cwd, not args: Hermes MCP children must be launched via a .cmd wrapper that cds into the indexed repo first; quote paths (Hermes Agent has a space). One server maps one repo root.

n8n MCP on this setup: `hermes mcp login` never completes (fails before showing grant URL). Working path is manual PKCE: DCR at /mcp-oauth/register, listener on pinned oauth.redirect_port, user opens authorize URL, exchange code, store mcp-tokens/n8n.json + n8n.meta.json. Valid n8n scopes are workflow:/execution:/agent:/credential:/dataTable:/project:/tag:/communityPackage:/aiPreference: prefixed, never openid.

Neocoder MCP headers using {env:VAR} fail with 401 when VAR exists in registry but not in the live server process env (setx needs a full process-tree restart, not a UI reopen). Diagnose via registry-vs-process two-layer check.
